description: Refactor selected low-risk mutation workflows from client-side internal API fetch calls to Next.js Server Actions while preserving existing behavior and UI.

userStories.title: Define server action mutation architecture and migration guardrails
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a standard Server Action mutation pattern so that migrated workflows are consistent, secure, and maintainable.
acceptanceCriteria: Document a standard Server Action mutation pattern covering input validation, authorization, typed success/error responses, and cache revalidation
Implement at least one shared helper or convention used by multiple server actions to reduce duplication
Create a mapping of targeted API mutation route behavior to equivalent Server Action behavior before migration implementation
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Migrate one low-risk settings mutation workflow to Server Actions
userStories.description: As a user, I want settings updates to save exactly as before so that the workflow is unchanged after server-side migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrate one low-risk settings mutation flow from client-side `/api/*` fetch to a Server Action
Preserve existing success and failure UX copy and interaction behavior for the migrated settings flow
Do not introduce new user-visible fields, controls, or layout changes in the touched settings UI
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Migrate one low-risk entity mutation workflow to Server Actions
userStories.description: As a user, I want create and update operations in one low-risk entity area to remain reliable after moving mutations to Server Actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrate one entity mutation flow (for example provider mappings, categories, or category rules) from client-side API fetch to a Server Action
Validation and error handling outcomes remain equivalent to current behavior
Persisted data is correct and visible after refresh or navigation
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add parity-focused regression coverage for migrated mutations
userStories.description: As a developer, I want confidence checks around migrated mutation workflows so that refactoring does not introduce regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update tests for each migrated mutation workflow at the existing project-appropriate layer
Cover happy-path and at least one failure-path for each migrated workflow
Keep related existing tests passing without weakening assertions
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Remove obsolete client mutation fetch logic for migrated workflows
userStories.description: As a developer, I want legacy client mutation fetch plumbing removed so that the codebase is simpler and less error-prone.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove direct client mutation calls to `/api/...` endpoints for workflows migrated in this PRD
Delete dead migration-related client code in touched modules, including unused hooks, helpers, and state branches
Keep migration scope limited to selected low-risk mutation flows and leave unrelated workflows untouched
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
